question: Spot the **correct spelling** of a microchip printing method.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Photolithography .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "Photolithography" is a microchip printing method and is the correct spelling.
 
• The other options provided are incorrect spellings:
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Photolithographe" is incorrect because of the added "e" at the end.
 
• **Option 3:** "Photolitography" is incorrect due to the missing "h" in "litho".
 
• **Option 4:** "Potolithography" is incorrect as the "Ph" is misspelled as "Po".
 
 

Correct spelling: *Photolithography*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Photolithography** is a process used in semiconductor manufacturing to transfer patterns onto a substrate using light. It is a crucial step in creating microchips.
 
• The word comes from "photo" (light) and "lithography" (stone printing), which is derived from Greek words.
